heading: Trump dodged Yemen's plea for military support amid Houthi attacks on Riyadh: Report
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: President Trump did not commit US forces to aid Yemen against the Houthis.  Yemeni President Alimi sought American backing for his government's efforts.  US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, discussing a ceasefire.  Trump reportedly called off planned airstrikes against Houthi targets.  The conflict has caused significant casualties and displacement within Yemen.
